rationale: Tighten successor v0.6 after gate review showed two remaining release blockers: the L3 recovery case produced human-readable but evaluator-incompatible artifacts, and the memory required-delta gate was mathematically impossible when the baseline already scored at the ceiling. The change preserves the existing budget contract, adds explicit L3 recovery contract guidance for observable collapse/regroup events, top-level recovery.json fields, compatibility database columns, and public self-checks, while external release code handles saturated baselines as non-regression guardrails.
